name: Learning Curve Destroyer
description: Diagnose gaps, simulate errors, explain the subject back simply, and produce a personal learning path.
purpose: Help the user learn a skill faster by finding confusion points and converting them into a concrete practice plan.

stages.name: Hidden Gap Detector
stages.description: Find likely missing concepts, fragile assumptions, and terms the user may be skipping past.

steps.label: Map the target skill or subject from the provided context.
Identify hidden prerequisite gaps and likely confusion points.
Rank gaps by impact on learning speed.

stages.name: Real Error Simulator
stages.description: Generate realistic mistakes and correction drills for the highest-impact gaps.

steps.label: Create realistic failure cases based on the detected gaps.
Explain the correction pattern for each failure.
Convert the concept into a simple Feynman-style explanation prompt.

stages.name: Personal Learning Path
stages.description: Turn the findings into a practice sequence with checkpoints.

steps.label: Create a focused learning path with daily practice blocks.
Define verification checkpoints and pass/fail criteria.
Give the first concrete action to start immediately.

userFacingBlurb: Find the hidden gaps, simulate mistakes, and get a practical learning path.
